feature: TS-ACR hold untuk company yang tidak ditemukan, sudah de-registered, atau data wajib/alamat kosong pada sync UEN
note: Saat sync UEN, notice company yang tidak ada di ACRA, de-registered, beralamat kosong, atau tanpa Entity Name/Type/Status/Company Type Code di-TS-ACR dan tidak diproses lanjut. Tidak disebut di story OCMS11.41 (mungkin termasuk story Epic OCMS8); job sync UEN nonaktif di prod.
note_en: During the UEN sync, a company notice that is not in ACRA, is de-registered, has a blank address, or lacks Entity Name/Type/Status/Company Type Code gets TS-ACR and is not processed further. Not mentioned in story OCMS11.41 (may belong to an Epic OCMS8 story); the UEN sync job is inactive in prod.

feature: Pengecualian MID/DIP (PS-MID/PS-DIP) dan TS-CLV untuk VIP pada letter RR3/DR3 serta admin fee RR3/DR3
note: Pembuatan letter RR3 mengeluarkan kendaraan MID/DIP dan memberi PS-MID/PS-DIP, menerapkan TS-CLV untuk VIP setelah stage maju, dan menambah admin fee ke amount_payable. Tidak disebut di OCMS11.42 (kemungkinan dicakup story Epic OCMS17/admin fee); tidak diklaim di sini.
note_en: RR3 letter generation removes MID/DIP vehicles and applies PS-MID/PS-DIP, applies TS-CLV for VIP vehicles after the stage advances, and adds the admin fee to amount_payable. Not mentioned in OCMS11.42 (probably covered by an Epic OCMS17/admin fee story); not claimed here.
